notes: `upstream` is the Isol8 PAPERCLIP FORK image (ghcr.io/isol8ai/paperclip, built by the fork's own CI from branch isol8/2026.7-circuit-breaker, tag v2026.7-isol8.8), pinned by DIGEST. v2026.7-isol8.8 REBASED the whole patch stack onto upstream master 2137f85e1 (2026-07-31, past the v2026.722.0 tag), which brings upstream's managerial layer into the image: routable blocked transitions (migration 0184 — entering `blocked` requires a blocker edge, a pending interaction naming a responder, or a structured {owner,action} descriptor whose owner is actively notified; prose-only blocked is rejected or auto-needs_attention), trust-gated direct-parent report comments (a run on a child issue may comment on its direct parent under the standard preset), interaction withdrawal + terminal-issue expiry of pending cards, quieter recovery notices, and the bundled-plugin catalog. Rebase surgeries to know about: our routine-circuit-breaker migration was renumbered 0182 -> 0197 (journal `when` preserved at 1784300000000 so already-migrated DBs skip it — verified against drizzle's migrator, which applies an entry only when its folderMillis exceeds the last applied created_at — and the SQL is IF NOT EXISTS as a second guard), and the isol8.notifications plugin now registers through upstream's BUNDLED_PLUGIN_CATALOG + SELF_HOSTED_AUTO_INSTALL_KEYS in server/src/services/bundled-plugins.ts (upstream replaced the ad-hoc auto-install chain in app.ts; the production image stage still builds and carries the plugin's dist, and PAPERCLIP_ISOL8_NOTIFY_URL/_TOKEN wiring in paperclip-stack.ts is unchanged). NEW fork patches in isol8.8: accepted-interaction requeue backoff (consecutive failed continuation runs of ANY error code stretch the recovery requeue interval from 5 minutes up to a 1-hour ceiling instead of re-dispatching a full agent run every reconcile tick; the interaction is never abandoned and the waiting-on-review cap is untouched) and a productivity-review stale sweep (reconcile cancels open reviews once their source issue reaches a terminal status, with a system comment). Carried patches, all still real source on the fork: the routine circuit breaker, the agent-delete routines-FK fix, honest run-log workspace/session-reset lines for cloud-adapter runs, the 400 guard on non-UUID X-Paperclip-Run-Id headers, complete child-row cleanup on issue delete, the agent-comment whitespace fix, the resilient detached agent.wait (<=5-min slices across the API Gateway 2h WS cap, 48h ceiling), the FK-safe company delete (COMPANY_DELETE_SEQUENCE), daily-cap retry parking, the PAPERCLIP_SKIP_BUILTIN_AGENTS gate (Isol8 tenants get exactly Friday+Atlas; wired in paperclip-stack.ts), and the bundled isol8.notifications forwarder (approval.created/resubmitted + agent.run.finished/failed -> backend /webhooks/paperclip-events; unconfigured instances no-op). The extended Dockerfile is a thin passthrough that re-tags this image into ECR so per-tenant ECS tasks can pull it with execution-role creds (the fork GHCR package is private; the build authenticates with GITHUB_TOKEN and the package grants Isol8AI/isol8 read access). `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev/prod. `upstreamCommit` is the FORK commit (drives the extended tag). Bump `upstream` here to the fork's new digest when shipping fork changes.
